capabilities: run provider-native agent CLIs against the vault as their working directory
chat with agents in a sidebar with multi-tab conversations, fork, resume, and compact
preview word-level diffs of agent edits before applying them, or enable YOLO mode
track agent handoffs on a kanban board from inbox to done
save and reuse prompts via quick actions, slash commands, and skills
disambiguation: Not a code-only developer tool; the README says it is for anyone who works in notes, from writers to small-business owners.
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Linux, Windows), requires Obsidian v1.11.5+; README includes a security model warning that agents run as subprocesses that can edit files and execute shell commands, and notes a post-1.0 roadmap called the Specorator Agent Harness PRD. No telemetry; credentials stored in OS keychain.
intentEvidence: began as a fork of the original Claudian Obsidian plugin by Yishen Tu
problem: AI work lives in scattered browser tabs and vanishes when closed, and agent edits reach notes without any review step.
